title_zh: 从来不下班的快递小哥
title_en: The Courier Who Never Clocked Off
note_en: 又 A 又 B means "both A and B at once," linking two qualities or feelings true at the same moment. In the text: 小林又好笑又不好意思 "Xiao Lin found it both funny and embarrassing." Unlike 一边…一边…, which describes two ongoing processes, 又…又… simply lists traits; both parts are usually short and parallel: 又高又瘦 "tall and thin," 又快又好 "fast and good."
